card.name: Words just before 'instructions' or 'directions'
card.fires_on: Words right before the noun 'instructions' or 'directions', such as 'follow the', 'for detailed' or 'for complete'. Mostly in label text that sends the reader to the usage instructions.

modes.label: Referral to instructions
modes.description: Modifier after 'for' that points to a full set of instructions or directions.
modes.example: See Detailed Patient Labeling for<< detailed>> instruction.

modes.label: Follow the instructions
modes.description: The verb or article in 'follow the ... instructions' directing the reader to steps.
modes.example: Click on the link in the yellow box and<< follow>> the log-in instructions.

card.writes: It makes the next word 'instructions' or 'directions' more likely and word-like terms such as argument or scheme less likely.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say 'instructions', as in 'see the instructions for use'.
